verdict.rationale: Bruno's CLI and CI/CD integration allow collections to be run automatically in pipelines (bruno-docs-1, bruno-docs-3, bruno-docs-18), which could be scheduled to run unattended, but there is no evidence of AI-native or agentic automation features (triggers, scheduling, autonomous decision-making) beyond generic CI/CD scripting. Missing for 10: dedicated scheduling/automation engine, AI-driven autonomous execution logic, evidence of background/agentic runs beyond CI pipelines.
